Therefore the question cannot be answered with the current schema.

SELECT p.product_id,
       s.phone_number
FROM Products AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.product_id, c.staff_id
    FROM Complaints AS c
    WHERE c.date_complaint_raised = (
        SELECT MIN(c2.date_complaint_raised)
        FROM Complaints AS c2
        WHERE c2.product_id = c.product_id
    )
) AS pc ON p.product_id = pc.product_id
LEFT JOIN Staff AS s ON pc.staff_id = s.staff_id;

votes.sql:
WITH complaint_counts AS (
        SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
        FROM Complaints
        GROUP BY product_id
    ),
    staff_primary AS (
        SELECT product_id,
               staff_id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
        FROM Complaints
        GROUP BY product_id, staff_id
    ),
    category_avg AS (
        SELECT product_category_code,
               AVG(product_price) AS avg_price
        FROM Products
        GROUP BY product_category_code
    )
SELECT p.product_name,
       p.product_category_code,
       COALESCE(cc.complaint_count, 0) AS complaint_count,
       (s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name) AS staff_full_name,
       ca.avg_price
FROM Products p
LEFT JOIN complaint_counts cc ON p.product_id = cc.product_id
LEFT JOIN staff_primary sp ON p.product_id = sp.product_id AND sp.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN Staff s ON sp.staff_id = s.staff_id
JOIN category_avg ca ON p.product_category_code = ca.product_category_code
ORDER BY COALESCE(cc.complaint_count, 0) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.product_name,
    p.product_category_code,
    COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count,
    MIN(s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name) AS staff_full_name,
    AVG(p.product_price) OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_category_code) AS avg_category_price
FROM Products p
LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON p.product_id = c.product_id
LEFT JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC

WITH complaints_cnt AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt
  FROM Complaints
  GROUP BY product_id
),
staff_cnt AS (
  SELECT product_id, staff_id, COUNT(*) AS staff_cnt
  FROM Complaints
  GROUP BY product_id, staff_id
),
ranked_staff AS (
  SELECT product_id, staff_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY staff_cnt DESC, staff_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM staff_cnt
),
best_staff AS (
  SELECT rs.product_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
  FROM ranked_staff rs
  JOIN Staff s ON rs.staff_id = s.staff_id
  WHERE rs.rn = 1
),
avg_price_cat AS (
  SELECT product_category_code, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price_per_category
  FROM Products
  GROUP BY product_category_code
)
SELECT
  p.product_name,
  p.product_category_code,
  cc.complaint_cnt AS total_complaints,
  bs.first_name || ' ' || bs.last_name AS staff_full_name,
  apc.avg_price_per_category
FROM Products p
JOIN complaints_cnt cc ON p.product_id = cc.product_id
JOIN best_staff bs ON p.product_id = bs.product_id
JOIN avg_price_cat apc ON p.product_category_code = apc.product_category_code
ORDER BY total_complaints DESC;

SELECT p.product_name,
       s.first_name,
       s.last_name
FROM Products p
JOIN (
    SELECT c.product_id, c.staff_id
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, MIN(date_complaint_raised) AS min_date
        FROM Complaints
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) m ON c.product_id = m.product_id AND c.date_complaint_raised = m.min_date
) AS first_c ON p.product_id = first_c.product_id
JOIN Staff s ON first_c.staff_id = s.staff_id
ORDER BY p.product_name;
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM Products p JOIN Complaints c ON p.product_id = c.product_id JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id

votes.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE prod_hierarchy AS (
        SELECT product_id,
               product_id AS root_id
        FROM Products
        WHERE parent_product_id IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT p.product_id,
               h.root_id
        FROM Products p
        JOIN prod_hierarchy h ON p.parent_product_id = h.product_id
),
customer_revenue AS (
        SELECT c.customer_id,
               h.root_id AS product_family_id,
               SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue
        FROM Complaints c
        JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
        JOIN prod_hierarchy h ON p.product_id = h.product_id
        GROUP BY c.customer_id, h.root_id
)
SELECT 
        cr.customer_id,
        cr.product_family_id,
        cr.total_revenue,
        AVG(cr.total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY cr.product_family_id) AS avg_family_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.product_family_id ORDER BY cr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM customer_revenue cr
ORDER BY cr.product_family_id, revenue_rank;

WITH RECURSIVE ProductHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        product_id AS family_root_id
    FROM Products
    WHERE parent_product_id IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        ph.family_root_id
    FROM Products p
    INNER JOIN ProductHierarchy ph ON p.parent_product_id = ph.product_id
),
CustomerProductRevenues AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        ph.family_root_id AS product_family_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS gross_revenue
    FROM Complaints comp
    INNER JOIN Customers c ON comp.customer_id = c.customer_id
    INNER JOIN Products p ON comp.product_id = p.product_id
    INNER JOIN ProductHierarchy ph ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, ph.family_root_id
),
RankedSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        product_family_id,
        gross_revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(gross_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_family_id), 2) AS cohort_average_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_family_id ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC) AS spending_rank
    FROM CustomerProductRevenues
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    product_family_id,
    gross_revenue,
    cohort_average_revenue,
    spending_rank
FROM RankedSpending;
ORDER BY product_family_id, spending_rank;

WITH earliest AS (
    SELECT c.product_id, c.staff_id
    FROM Complaints c
    WHERE c.date_complaint_raised = (
        SELECT MIN(c2.date_complaint_raised)
        FROM Complaints c2
        WHERE c2.product_id = c.product_id
    )
)
SELECT p.product_name,
       s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS full_name,
       s.email_address
FROM Products p
JOIN earliest e ON e.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Staff s ON s.staff_id = e.staff_id
WHERE p.date_product_discontinued IS NULL
   OR p.date_product_discontinued > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS staff_full_name, s.email_address FROM Products p INNER JOIN Complaints c ON p.product_id = c.product_id INNER JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id WHERE p.date_product_discontinued IS NULL

SELECT p.product_name,
       s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS full_name,
       s.email_address
FROM Products p
JOIN (
    SELECT c.product_id, c.staff_id
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, MIN(date_complaint_raised) AS min_date
        FROM Complaints
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) mc ON c.product_id = mc.product_id AND c.date_complaint_raised = mc.min_date
) earliest ON p.product_id = earliest.product_id
JOIN Staff s ON earliest.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE p.date_product_discontinued IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name AS staff_first_name,
                s.last_name  AS staff_last_name,
                c.customer_id AS customer_id
FROM Complaints AS co
JOIN Staff      AS s ON co.staff_id = s.staff_id
JOIN Customers  AS c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id;
SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name, c.customer_id FROM Staff s INNER JOIN Complaints comp ON s.staff_id = comp.staff_id INNER JOIN Customers c ON comp.customer_id = c.customer_id

votes.sql:
WITH staff_per_category AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_code,
        s.staff_id,
        s.first_name,
        s.last_name,
        COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_category_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_code, s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
)
SELECT
    product_category_code,
    first_name || ' ' || last_name AS staff_name
FROM staff_per_category
WHERE rn = 1;

votes.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE staff_product_descendants AS (
    SELECT c.staff_id, p.product_id, p.product_price, 0 AS depth
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT spd.staff_id, pc.product_id, pc.product_price, spd.depth + 1
    FROM staff_product_descendants spd
    JOIN Products pc ON pc.parent_product_id = spd.product_id
)
SELECT staff_id,
       SUM(product_price) AS total_child_price
FROM staff_product_descendants
WHERE depth > 0
GROUP BY staff_id;

SELECT 
    c.staff_id,
    SUM(p_child.product_price) AS total_child_product_price
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Products p_complained ON c.product_id = p_complained.product_id
JOIN Products p_child ON p_complained.product_id = p_child.parent_product_id
GROUP BY c.staff_id

WITH RECURSIVE desc_products AS (
    SELECT c.product_id AS root_product_id, p.product_id AS descendant_id
    FROM "Complaints" c
    JOIN "Products" p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dp.root_product_id, prod.product_id
    FROM desc_products dp
    JOIN "Products" prod ON prod.parent_product_id = dp.descendant_id
)
SELECT s.staff_id,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_child_price
FROM desc_products dp
JOIN "Products" p ON p.product_id = dp.descendant_id
JOIN "Complaints" c ON c.product_id = dp.root_product_id
JOIN "Staff" s ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
WHERE p.product_id <> dp.root_product_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id;

votes.sql:
WITH total_hw AS (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS total_cnt
        FROM Products
        WHERE product_category_code = 'Hardware'
    ),
    staff_customer AS (
        SELECT c.staff_id,
               COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_cnt
        FROM Complaints c
        JOIN Customers cust ON c.customer_id = cust.customer_id
        GROUP BY c.staff_id
        HAVING cust_cnt >= 30
           AND MIN(cust.customer_type_code) = 'Good Credit Rating'
           AND MAX(cust.customer_type_code) = 'Good Credit Rating'
    ),
    staff_hw_coverage AS (
        SELECT c.staff_id,
               COUNT(DISTINCT c.product_id) AS prod_cnt
        FROM Complaints c
        JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
        WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
        GROUP BY c.staff_id
    ),
    staff_avg_resolution AS (
        SELECT c.staff_id,
               AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS avg_resolution_days
        FROM Complaints c
        JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
        WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
        GROUP BY c.staff_id
    )
SELECT
    a.staff_id,
    a.avg_resolution_days,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_resolution_days ASC) AS rank
FROM staff_avg_resolution a
JOIN staff_customer sc ON a.staff_id = sc.staff_id
JOIN staff_hw_coverage sh ON a.staff_id = sh.staff_id
JOIN total_hw t ON 1 = 1
WHERE sh.prod_cnt = t.total_cnt
ORDER BY rank;

WITH hardware_subcategories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_product_id
    FROM Products
    WHERE product_category_code = 'Hardware'
),
staff_good_credit_hardware AS (
    SELECT 
        c.staff_id,
        c.product_id,
        c.customer_id,
        c.parent_product_id,
        julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised) AS resolution_time
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Customers cust ON c.customer_id = cust.customer_id
    WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
      AND cust.customer_type_code = 'Good Credit Rating'
      AND c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
),
staff_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        staff_id,
        AVG(resolution_time) AS avg_resolution_time,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS good_credit_customer_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT parent_product_id) AS subcategories_handled
    FROM staff_good_credit_hardware
    GROUP BY staff_id
),
total_subcategories AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS subcategory_count FROM hardware_subcategories
)
SELECT 
    s.staff_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.avg_resolution_time ASC) AS rank_number
FROM staff_stats s
CROSS JOIN total_subcategories t
WHERE s.good_credit_customer_count >= 30
  AND s.subcategories_handled = t.subcategory_count
ORDER BY s.avg_resolution_time ASC;

WITH hardware_products AS (
    SELECT product_id, parent_product_id
    FROM Products
    WHERE product_category_code = 'Hardware'
),
hardware_subcategories AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT parent_product_id) AS total_subcats
    FROM hardware_products
    WHERE parent_product_id IS NOT NULL
),
staff_hardware AS (
    SELECT c.staff_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT hp.parent_product_id) AS handled_subcats
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN hardware_products hp ON c.product_id = hp.product_id
    GROUP BY c.staff_id
),
staff_customers AS (
    SELECT c.staff_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cu.customer_type_code = 'Good Credit Rating' THEN c.customer_id END) AS good_customers,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cu.customer_type_code <> 'Good Credit Rating' THEN c.customer_id END) AS other_customers
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.staff_id
),
eligible_staff AS (
    SELECT sc.staff_id
    FROM staff_customers sc
    JOIN staff_hardware sh ON sc.staff_id = sh.staff_id
    CROSS JOIN hardware_subcategories hs
    WHERE sc.other_customers = 0
      AND sc.good_customers >= 30
      AND sh.handled_subcats = hs.total_subcats
)
SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(c.date_complaint_closed) - JULIANDAY(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS average_resolution_time_days
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
  AND c.staff_id IN (SELECT staff_id FROM eligible_staff)
GROUP BY c.staff_id
ORDER BY average_resolution_time_days ASC;
